WITH date_set AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE (d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999) OR (d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999)
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name, MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_set)
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
    GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
),
filtered_store_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_set)
    WHERE ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_set)
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk = cs_item_sk
    JOIN customer ON sr_bill_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk
    GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc
)
SELECT fss.i_item_id, fss.i_item_desc, fss.s_store_id, fss.s_store_name, fss.store_sales_profit, fsr.sr_net_loss, fcs.catalog_sales_profit
FROM filtered_store_sales fss
JOIN store_returns sr ON fss.ss_customer_sk = sr.customer_sk AND fss.ss_item_sk = sr.item_sk AND fss.ss_ticket_number = sr.ticket_number
JOIN filtered_catalog_sales fcs ON fss.i_item_id = fcs.i_item_id
ORDER BY fss.i_item_id, fss.i_item_desc, fss.s_store_id, fss.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
